author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More for When the Silent Bird Sings
content:
HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ↳

We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects.

These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more.

These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships.

If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: Name, general location, Position applying for, Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples, Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-), Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary), Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work, Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc), Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use), Other notable experience / specializations.

*NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE*

ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES.

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for JUMP ANIMATION
content:
WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS

JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project!

Requirements: Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. Ability to match an established cartoon art style. Attention to detail and good artistic skills.

Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance).

Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com. You can also message us directly through Facebook!

author: egofilm_studio
title: EGoFILM seeking Lead Illustrator and Background Illustrator
content:
EGoFILM poszukuje Lead Ilustratora oraz Background Ilustratora!

Do nowego projektu serialu animowanego szukamy osoby, która będzie odpowiedzialna między innymi za: projektowanie i rozwijanie lokacji oraz backgroundów (background ilustrator), współtworzenie warstwy wizualnej serialu (lead ilustrator), dbanie o spójność stylistyczną ilustracji (lead ilustrator), współpracę z Art Directorem, reżyserami oraz zespołem ilustratorów (lead ilustrator).

Jeśli masz doświadczenie w pracy przy projektach animowanych, prześlij swoje portfolio na: rekrutacja@egofilm.pl

author: mtaartsdesign
title: MTA Arts & Design looking for artists for LIRR stations
content: Artists, this is your stop! Your artwork could become part of New Yorkers’ everyday commute! MTA Arts & Design is looking for artists for the LIRR Bellerose and Floral Park stations. Artists working in all mediums are welcome to apply! Deadline: November 20, 2026. Submit your portfolio: Link in bio.

author: factornotes
title: Factor Notes hiring Illustrator for stationery and brand campaigns
content: We’re looking for a talented and detail-oriented Illustrator to join our team and create original artwork for our stationery collections and brand campaigns. What You’ll Do: Illustration & Artwork, Concept Development, Team Collaboration, Creative Exploration. Who You Are: 0–3 years experience, proficient in Adobe Illustrator and Procreate. Interested? Mail your resume and portfolio to: careers@factornotes.com
